functional.text: Borrow: a member checks out an available copy; the loan is due in 14 days.
Return: checking in a copy closes the loan, charges a fine if late, and offers the copy to the next reservation.
Search the catalogue by title, author or subject and see available copies.
Rules: at most 5 items per member, renew once if nobody is waiting, fine per day overdue.
Reserve a title when all copies are out; the first in the queue is notified and has 3 days to collect.

non_functional.text: A copy is never lent to two members, even when two desks act at once.
Fine rules and notification channels change without editing the lending code.

assumptions.text: ~50k titles, several physical copies per popular title, each with a barcode.

out_of_scope.text: E-books, inter-library loans, payment of fines.

api.notes: Fails if the member is at the limit, owes fines, or the copy is held for someone else.

api.response: fine in cents (0 if on time)
api.notes: Closes the loan; raises CopyAvailable for the reservation queue.
Renew refused when the title has reservations.

deep_dives.title: Fines

options.name: FinePolicy strategy
options.pros: per-day, capped or zero rules are separate classes

deep_dives.choice: FinePolicy interface (PerDayFine, CappedFine, NoFine) chosen per item category
deep_dives.why: Loan only knows dates; the penalty rule is the part the library keeps changing (open/closed).

deep_dives.title: Telling waiting members

options.name: return_copy calls the email client
options.cons: lending depends on a channel; hard to add SMS

deep_dives.choice: Observer: ReservationQueue listens for CopyAvailable and uses a Notifier interface
deep_dives.why: Return logic stays small; channels (email, SMS) are pluggable Notifier implementations.

wrapup.bottlenecks: Search across 50k titles: an inverted index on title/author/subject rather than a scan.
wrapup.failures: Notification failure leaves the hold active and is retried; a lost copy moves to LOST and closes the loan with a replacement fee.
wrapup.monitoring: Loans per day, overdue count, average reservation wait.
wrapup.scale: Two desks borrowing the last copy: claim it with a compare-and-set on its status (or a row lock in the DB) and check the member limit in the same transaction. New media types (DVD, magazine) are new item subclasses; branches are a location on the copy.
wrapup.future: E-books as a copy with unlimited or licensed concurrency; inter-library loans as a new copy source.
